n: MIT family friendly data privacy and AI activities
t: Four activities from MIT on recommendations, ads, consent, and AI debates for young learners.
steps: Find the MIT Media Lab post about family-friendly data privacy and AI activities.
Follow the post's link to the activity materials on the MIT AI education site.
Watch the overview video and read the syllabus.
Pick the activity that matches the age of your group.
Print the worksheets or load the slides.
Read the teaching notes and plan the discussion questions.
Share the at-home debate guide with families after the class.
